How to choose well

Five questions that matter more than a catchy advertisement.

  1. 01

    Who awards the qualification?

    Separate NGA’s preparation or training role from any external certifying institution.

  2. 02

    What is the complete cost?

    Ask about tuition, hostel, uniform, medicals, documents, exams and travel.

  3. 03

    Do I meet medical and academic rules?

    Verify them before payment; rules can change by pathway.

  4. 04

    What support is actually included?

    Get the training schedule, practical components and career-guidance scope in writing.

  5. 05

    What if a job takes time?

    Understand the market and build backup skills rather than relying on a promise.

Straight answers

Before comparing course fees.

A low headline fee is not useful unless you know what is excluded.

What is the total cost, beyond the course fee?

Ask for a written cost sheet covering tuition, registration, medical tests, documents, uniform, accommodation, food, examination and travel where applicable. [CONFIRM: Insert National Global Academy’s current fee and inclusions.] Do not rely on a verbal “all inclusive” statement.

Is a job guaranteed after the course?

No responsible academy can guarantee employment or a fixed salary. National Global Academy provides training and career guidance. Selection depends on eligibility, medical fitness, performance, documents, vacancies and the employer’s process.

Is life onboard safe, and is it suitable for girls?

Reputable shipping and cruise employers maintain onboarding rules, grievance channels and workplace conduct policies, but conditions vary by company and ship. Students—including women—should verify the employer, reporting channels, accommodation arrangements and contract before joining. Families should keep copies of every document and maintain regular contact.

What are the eyesight and medical rules?

Standards differ by role and pathway. Marine deck pathways can include colour-vision and eyesight requirements; hospitality roles have their own fitness expectations. Always complete the relevant assessment with an approved or employer-accepted medical professional, as per current DG Shipping guidelines where applicable, before paying substantial fees.
